calls.body: On power play, Dallas sits 2nd of 32, at the lethal end of the scale. St. Louis is 31st, at the harmless end.

surprises.head: St. Louis got to the dangerous areas
surprises.body: St. Louis needed 9.7 unblocked shots per expected goal at 5-on-5, against its usual 15.0 and a league average of 15.9. Over the last three seasons, a team strayed this far about once every 100 games.

surprises.head: J. Hofer stole one
surprises.body: J. Hofer allowed 0 goals on shots worth 2.8 expected goals, 2.8 fewer than expected. Starting goalies had a night this good about once every 45 starts over the last three seasons.
